name: Impact image macro
summary: A square photo or a cartoon with white capital text in a thick black outline at the top and the bottom. The Impact typeface and the format spread on forums and 4chan from 2006.

philosophy.core_thesis: Make the caption the picture: one setup line on top, one punch line below, in a font that stays legible at any size.
design_principles: Set text in Impact or an open look-alike (Anton, Oswald 700) in white capitals.
Add a black outline of 3px to 4px per 40px of text, drawn outside the glyph.
Place the setup line at the top and the punch line at the bottom, each 5% to 8% from the edge.
Size the text so that each line spans 80% to 95% of the width; break to a second line at 24 characters.
Crop the picture to a square or to 4:3 and let it fill the whole canvas.
Use a picture with an obvious face or pose; no logo, no border, no extra graphics.
Keep the captions short: 3 to 8 words in each line.
anti_patterns: A decorative frame around the picture

layout.grid_mechanics: A full-bleed square canvas (for example 600px x 600px); two text bands, top and bottom, each 18% of the height.
layout.whitespace_ratio: No empty space: the picture fills 100% of the canvas and the text sits on it.
layout.alignment_rules: Centred text on one vertical axis; the lines never touch the side edges.
layout.container_geometry: Rectangular canvas with a 0px radius; no containers.

font_pairings.note: Impact itself is a proprietary font; Anton is the open look-alike.
A lighter condensed pair for smaller captions.

hierarchy_rules: Use one size for both lines: 12% of the canvas height.
Use bold weight only, in upper case.
Use white fill with a black outline; no other colour.

color.palette_structure: White text and black outline over the colour of the photograph; no designed palette.
color.contrast_rules: White with a black outline stays legible on any photo; the outline gives 21:1 to the fill.
color.surface_treatment: The photograph is shown as it is, with a little extra saturation.
color.light_and_shadow: No designed light; the outline acts as a hard shadow.

materiality.surface_simulation: A digital photograph, often cropped from a small file with visible JPEG grain.
materiality.border_rules: A text outline of 3px to 4px in black; no frame.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur; a 2px offset shadow on the text is optional.

ornamentation_details.iconography: No icons; the type is the only mark.
ornamentation_details.illustration: A stock photo, a screen capture or a cartoon face; one subject.

motion.transition_physics: Static image. A GIF version holds the caption and swaps the picture each 400ms.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover scales the text by 2% with no easing.

emotion.target_response: The viewer reads the joke in two seconds and shares it.

avoid_when: The brand needs a calm, premium tone.
The text is longer than two short lines.

modifiers.how: Keep the picture but drop the top and bottom caption for one odd line and a strange crop.
Raise contrast and saturation, recompress to JPEG quality 10 and add glow to the text.
Remove the Impact captions and add small labels on the people or objects in the picture.

pack.why: A sharp solid family with hard corners that matches thick outlined capitals.

ground.why: The ground is the raw photograph; the page shows no designed surface.
